venue.name: Henschel Fine Arts
venue.description: Henschel Fine Arts is an arts venue in Port McNeill, at the north end of Vancouver Island. It has no working website, so nothing about what it offers, what it costs or when it is open could be confirmed. A phone call is the only way to find out whether it takes children's groups.

gaps: the catalog list carries no web address for this venue, and a single web search for "Henschel Fine Arts Port McNeill" returned only third-party directories, tourism listings and a stock photo page, with no official site on the venue's own domain

the domain recorded in the website field matches the venue's name and resolves in DNS, but it refuses connections on the secure port and times out on the plain one, from two independent network paths while other sites loaded normally; nothing could be read from it and it has not been confirmed as belonging to this venue
RETRIEVAL NOTE: this venue was recorded from zero readable pages. If the domain comes back up, the venue is worth re-running from scratch rather than treated as a venue with nothing to offer
the address and phone number that appear in third-party directories were deliberately not used, because they are not published on any page belonging to the venue
no address published on the venue's own site, so there is nothing to geocode
no hours, opening days or season are available from any source belonging to the venue
no booking email, phone, web form or lead time is available from any source belonging to the venue
nothing confirms whether the venue takes school or daycare groups at all, so no program could be recorded
no price, youngest age, group size limit, lunch space, washroom, rain backup or accessibility information is available
the category is set from the venue's name alone; nothing from the venue itself confirms what a visitor would see or do there
no image could be collected, because there is no readable page on the venue's own domain to collect one from, so there is no hero image and the catalog card will fall back to an initials tile
